fonts.usage: H1, H2, massive editorial text, 'RB' monogram
Body text, small caps labels, UI elements, navigation

layout_spacing.grid_strategy: Tetris Grid (Mode A) with asymmetry. Break out of perfect columns. Use col-span-full for hero, col-span-4/8 for experience sections.

surface_styles.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-[#262626] rounded-none p-8 hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] transition-colors duration-500

motion_interactions.hero_entrance: Staggered fade-up and slight scale down for typography via framer-motion.
motion_interactions.hover_states: Text color shifts to accent, subtle image zoom within hidden overflow containers.
motion_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for Skills. Slow, continuous, outline text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pure HTML/Tailwind high-end editorial layout. Do not use standard Shadcn cards for the main structure—use raw divs for asymmetry.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for huge headings and 'Outfit' for body. Add these via Google Fonts link in index.html.
Use framer-motion for staggering text reveals in the hero section.
The Contact Form must be functional (or mocked explicitly) using Resend API to send emails.
The Resume Download should be a prominent CTA.
Do NOT center everything. Left-align text for the Swiss Brutalist/Editorial feel.
Install react-fast-marquee for the skills section.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use the 'RB' monogram prominently as a graphic element.
